title: Ill Co. says a third party accessed the verification environment of its SaaS services and obtained some information, including some API credentials
date_note: Ill's notice (22 Nov) says it confirmed the unauthorized access on 18 November 2026; the notice gives no earlier day for the intrusion itself.
org: Ill Co., Ltd. (株式会社アイル)
geo_basis: country; the pages read do not state the company's city
summary: Ill Co. says that on 18 November 2026 it confirmed a third party had accessed the verification environment for its SaaS services and obtained some information. The notice lists test and demo data, test accounts, staff and partner contacts, member and order data used in integration testing, and some API credentials. Ill says production services show no unauthorized access and the number of affected records is still being verified.
plain: A Japanese SaaS company says an outsider got into its test environment and took some data, including some API credentials. It says its live services show no intrusion.
exec: A SaaS provider says its test environment held some real personal data and API credentials that were taken; the scope is still being checked.
action: Ill says it will contact affected customers and partners individually, is invalidating and reissuing the leaked API credentials, and is arranging an external forensic investigation.
impact: Ill says the number of affected records is still being verified.

validation.note: Primary: Ill's own notice of 22 Nov (read). Cybersecurity.com (Japan) relays it. The notice says the entry route is partly identified but still under investigation.

review.note: products: removed CROSS MALL and CROSS POINT, which the notice says were production services not accessed; rest matches the notice
